gen-gf-offside-gf-tiktok-sans: Wide, level, unshaded: Offside lets its curves stay open. Against that stretch, TikTok Sans stands tall and modern, its lowercase nearly reaching the capitals and its c generously open.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-tamil: Wallpoet: tall lowercase, smooth bends, paper showing through its letters. Noto Sans Tamil sits beneath it looking magnified, its terminals stopping well away from the stem, a contemporary counterweight to that loud top line.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-saira: Commanding from the first letter, Wallpoet rises high with smooth bends. Saira sits beside it clean and quiet, rounded lowercase stretching toward the top line, a hush after the shout.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-sofia-sans-semi-cond: Distinctive in its oversized lowercase, Unica One is all daylight inside the curves. Sofia Sans Semi Condensed nearly matches capitals with its lowercase, so both fonts feel tall and open.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-savate: Goldman spreads wide and bold, its round forms curving like open parentheses. Savate adds sturdy hairlines and a tall rounded o nearly matching the capital, with open jaws on every curve.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-amiko: Expressive Warnes draws ink strokes that taper out, with no shading. Warnes excels at bold, stretched tracking, while modern Amiko excels at tall, crayon-thick lowercase with outward-pointing terminals.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-anek-bangla: Anek Bangla keeps its s curves wide and barely curled. Warnes is a thread of ink that never swells or thins, stretched wide, which makes the approachable sans-serif below look compact.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-anek-gujarati: Anek Gujarati reads clean and approachable, its lowercase rivaling the capitals. Text in it should flow open and easy-going, with a gaping c, while Warnes supplies the uniform-width drama up top.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-mozilla-text: Mozilla Text looks bold, simply because its lowercase bodies are so tall. Warnes does stretched, spacious lettering in a constant line width best, while Mozilla Text does the flaring terminals best.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-gujarati: Thread-thin and widely spaced, Warnes draws every curve as a constant line of ink that tapers out. Warnes owns the spacing; Noto Sans Gujarati owns the open counters.
